_comment_top: Template for develop-settings.json — wizard-managed runtime config. Copy to develop-settings.json on first run. The Develop wizard at /develop populates real values; you only need this if you're configuring outside the wizard. develop-settings.json is gitignored so your project choices won't leak.
_comment_authMethod: GhCli (DEFAULT, recommended) → reads `gh auth token` dynamically; works for EMU accounts where PATs are blocked. AzureCliBearer → uses `az account get-access-token`; for Azure DevOps. Pat → static token (NOT RECOMMENDED — never put PATs in tracked files). ServicePrincipal → Azure SP for ADO.

gitHub._comment_pat: LEAVE EMPTY when authMethod=GhCli — the token comes from `gh auth token` at runtime. Set via `dotnet user-secrets` only if you must use authMethod=Pat (NOT recommended).

azureDevOps._comment_auth: LEAVE EMPTY when authMethod=AzureCliBearer — the token comes from `az account get-access-token` at runtime.
